Three-panel academic figure for a CoRL 2026 paper. Full width (textwidth), aspect ratio ~3:1, figsize (14, 4.5) inches, 300 DPI. THIS IS THE TRAINING-CONTRAST VERSION highlighting VLM-to-VLA vs VLA-to-VLA transition differences.

OVERALL STYLE:
- Publication quality for a TOP venue (NeurIPS/ICML/CoRL)
- PASTEL / LIGHT color palette — soft, elegant, NOT saturated
- White background, generous white space
- Serif font (Times New Roman) for titles, sans-serif (Helvetica) for labels
- Subtle drop shadows (2px, 8% opacity) on boxes
- Rounded corners (10px) on all rectangles
- Thin, elegant arrows — not bulky matplotlib defaults
- NO matplotlib default styling, NO gray background, NO tab10 colors
- Panel labels '(a)', '(b)', '(c)' in 14pt bold at top-left

COLOR PALETTE (pastel):
- Light sky blue: #B8D4E8, Light salmon: #F4A582, Mint green: #A6DBA0
- Light gold: #FDB863, Lavender: #C7B8E8, Rose: #E7B8D4
- Gray: #E8E8E8, Dark gray text: #4A4A4A, Soft red: #E07070

Panel (a) 'VLA sequence structure' (left, ~30% width):
Standard VLA sequence layout:
- Top: Sky blue rounded rect "Image tokens" with 4 small squares, "image_mean" label + downward arrow
- Middle: Gold rounded rect "Instruction tokens" with italic "pick up the red block"
- Red X: "cannot attend to instruction" in soft red
- Curved arrow: "attends to all context" in soft green
- Bottom: "R" lavender box (readout) + "Act" mint box (action)
- Thin vertical arrows connecting sections

Panel (b) 'Three analysis methods' (center, ~40% width):
Three numbered methods stacked vertically:

Method 1 "Layer-wise action probes":
- Circled "1" sky blue, bold title 12pt
- [L1][L2][L3] sky blue boxes -> [Probe] -> [7-DoF action], "R-squared" badge in salmon

Method 2 "Counterfactual perturbation":
- Circled "2", bold title 12pt
- 5 condition pills: "correct" (green), "empty" (gray), "wrong" (salmon), "shuffle" (gold), "paraph." (lavender)
- Arrow -> "delta-action"

Method 3 "L1 attention profiling":
- Circled "3", bold title 12pt
- 4x5 attention heatmap (light to medium blue), row labels: img, img, inst, ro
- Legend: "readout to instr." (blue), "readout to image" (salmon)

Panel (c) 'Finding classification' (right, ~30% width):
Three finding rows, each with CONTRAST MARKERS showing which transition type shows each finding:

Row 1: Circled "1" sky blue -> White box "Exit collapse (delta-R-squared > 0.10)" -> arrow -> "Training-associated" (sky_blue border)
BELOW: Two small pill tags side by side:
  "VLM to VLA: checkmark (6/6)" with mint green (#A6DBA0) background
  "VLA to VLA: X (0/4)" with soft rose (#E7B8D4) background

Row 2: Circled "2" salmon -> White box "CF sensitivity (d >= 0.45)" -> arrow -> "Action-linked" (salmon border)
BELOW: Two pills:
  "VLM to VLA: checkmark" mint green
  "VLA to VLA: checkmark" mint green

Row 3: Circled "3" gold -> White box "L1 instruction attention" -> arrow -> "Inherited prior" (gold border)
BELOW: Two pills:
  "VLM to VLA: checkmark" mint green
  "VLA to VLA: checkmark" mint green

KEY VISUAL INSIGHT: Exit collapse (Row 1) is the ONLY finding exclusive to VLM-to-VLA — the red X pill should visually stand out as the key differentiator.
